arxiv-2011-08626.title: Neural Semi-supervised Learning for Text Classification Under Large-Scale Pretraining
arxiv-2011-08626.creator: Zijun Sun, Chun Fan, Xiaofei Sun, Yuxian Meng, Fei Wu, Jiwei Li
arxiv-2011-08626.description: Abstract The goal of semi-supervised learning is to utilize the unlabeled, in-domain dataset U U to improve models trained on the labeled dataset D D . Under the context of large-scale language-model (LM) pretraining, how we can make the best use of U U is poorly understood: Is semi-supervised learning still beneficial with the presence of large-scale pretraining?

arxiv-2201-06953.title: Knowledge Tracing: A Survey
arxiv-2201-06953.creator: Ghodai Abdelrahman, Qing Wang, Bernardo Pereira Nunes
arxiv-2201-06953.description: Abstract . Humans’ ability to transfer knowledge through teaching is one of the essential aspects for human intelligence. A human teacher can track the knowledge of students to customize the teaching on students’ needs. With the rise of online education platforms, there is a similar need for machines to track the knowledge of students and tailor their learning experience.

arxiv-2206-04394.title: Xplique A Deep Learning Explainability Toolbox
arxiv-2206-04394.creator: Thomas Fel Lucas Hervier, David Vigouroux Antonin Poche Justin Plakoo Remi Cadene Mathieu Chalvidal, Julien Colin Thibaut Boissin Louis Bethune Agustin Picard Claire Nicodeme, Laurent Gardes Gregory Flandin Thomas Serre
arxiv-2206-04394.description: Abstract Today’s most advanced machine-learning models are hardly scrutable. The key challenge for explainability methods is to help assisting researchers in opening up these black boxes –– by revealing the strategy that led to a given decision, by characterizing their internal states or by studying the underlying data representation.

arxiv-2208-03560.title: Novel Supernumerary Robotic Limb based on Variable Stiffness Actuators for Hemiplegic Patients Assistance
arxiv-2208-03560.creator: Basma B. Hasanen, Mohammad I. Awad, Mohamed N. Boushaki, Zhenwei Niu, Mohammed A. Ramadan, Irfan Hussain
arxiv-2208-03560.description: Abstract Loss of upper extremity motor control and function is an unremitting symptom in post-stroke patients. This would impose hardships on accomplishing their daily life activities. Supernumerary robotic limbs (SRLs) were introduced as a solution to regain the lost Degrees of Freedom (DoFs) by introducing an independent new limb.

arxiv-2303-00053.title: Degenerate Topological Edge States in Multimer Chains
arxiv-2303-00053.creator: Jun Li, Yaping Yang, C.-M. Hu
arxiv-2303-00053.description: Abstract We propose and experimentally realize a class of quasi-one-dimensional topological lattices whose unit cells are constructed by coupled multiple identical resonators, with uniform hopping and inversion symmetry. In the presence of coupling-path-induced effective zero hopping within the unit cells, the systems are characterized by complete multimerization with degenerate − 1 -1 energy edge states for open boundary condition.

arxiv-2405-14066.title: Online Classification with Predictions
arxiv-2405-14066.creator: Vinod Raman and Ambuj Tewari
arxiv-2405-14066.description: Abstract We study online classification when the learner has access to predictions about future examples. We design an online learner whose expected regret is never worse than the worst-case regret, gracefully improves with the quality of the predictions, and can be significantly better than the worst-case regret when the predictions of future examples are accurate.

arxiv-2408-15846.title: Trading with Time Series Causal Discovery: An Empirical Study
arxiv-2408-15846.creator: Ruijie Tang
arxiv-2408-15846.description: Abstract This study investigates the application of causal discovery algorithms in equity markets, with a focus on their potential to build investment strategies. An investment strategy was developed based on the causal structures identified by these algorithms. The performance of the strategy is evaluated based on the profitability and effectiveness in stock markets.

arxiv-2411-12908.title: Untangling the interplay of the Equation-of-State and the Collision Term towards the generation of Directed and Elliptic Flow at intermediate energies
arxiv-2411-12908.creator: Tom Reichert, Jörg Aichelin
arxiv-2411-12908.description: Abstract The mechanism for generating directed and elliptic flow in heavy-ion collisions is investigated and quantified for the SIS18 and SIS100 energy regimes. The observed negative elliptic flow v 2 v_{2} , at midrapidity has been explained either via (in-plane) shadowing or via (out-of-plane) squeeze-out.

arxiv-2508-05086.title: Order-Disorder Transition and Phase Separation in Delay Vicsek Model Journal: New J. Phys.
arxiv-2508-05086.creator: Robert Horton, Viktor Holubec
arxiv-2508-05086.description: Abstract Interactions in active matter systems inherently involve delays due to information processing and actuation lags. We numerically investigate the impact of such delays on the phase behavior of the Vicsek model for motile active matter at a large but fixed system size .

arxiv-2509-06899.title: Space Mapping Optimization using Neural Networks for Efficient Parameter Estimation
arxiv-2509-06899.creator: Dhruvil Kamleshkumar Kotecha
arxiv-2509-06899.description: Abstract This project focuses on optimizing input parameters of a partial derivative function of a fine model using Neural network-based Space Mapping Optimization (SMO). The fine model is known for its high accuracy but is computationally expensive. On the other hand, the coarse model is represented by a neural network, which is much faster but less accurate.

arxiv-2606-02873.creator: Gaia Carenini

doe-osti-3015243-commercialization-of-pu.creator: Milostan, Cathy, Philip, Ritu, Stark, Gregory et al.
doe-osti-3015243-commercialization-of-pu.description: U.S. Department of Energy technical report. pmc-11296835.title: OCTS-09 THE PROSPECTIVE PHASE II COG-SRS TRIAL: AN UPDATE ON COGNITIVE-SPARING STEREOTACTIC RADIOSURGERY FOR BRAIN METASTASES
pmc-11296835.creator: Connor Puett, Austin Hopper, Michael Connor, Roshan Karunamuni, Parag Sanghvi, Grace Kim, Andrew Bruggeman, Kathryn Tringale, Vitali Moiseenko, Nikdokht Farid, Carrie McDonald, Jona Hattangadi-Gluth
pmc-11296835.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Stereotactic radiosurgery (SRS) plans that respect the neural correlates of cognition should result in better post-treatment cognitive outcomes compared to standard plans. The prospective phase II COG-SRS Trial is designed to test this hypothesis. To date, 92 treatment plans that ensure standard tumor coverage but also constrain doses to selected eloquent white matter tracts and the hippocampi have been developed for 70 patients with a total of 158 brain metastases arising from various cancer types.

pmc-11413676.title: Active infection at the time of CD34+ selected stem cell boost is associated with treatment failure and poor overall survival
pmc-11413676.creator: Roman M Shapiro, Haesook T Kim, Remy Dulery, Deborah Liney, Heather M Garrity, Kevin Panaro, Chloe Au, Casey Gervais, Jessica S Little, Vincent T Ho, Corey S Cutler, John Koreth, Mahasweta Gooptu, Joseph H Antin, Amar H Kelkar, Rizwan Romee, Catherine J Wu, Jerome Ritz, Robert J Soiffer, Sarah Nikif
pmc-11413676.description: Key Points•CD34+ selected SCB can restore hematopoiesis after PGF after allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell transplant.•An active infection at the time of CD34+ selected SCB is the strongest predictor of treatment failure and poor overall survival. Introduction The use of CD34+ selected stem cell boost (SCB) after an allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplant (allo-HCT) has been increasing in the last 20 years.

pmc-11710643.title: An AD‐associated variant in TTC3 alters the actin cytoskeleton organization and synaptic function in iPSC‐derived forebrain neurons
pmc-11710643.creator: Holly N. Cukier, Carolina L. Duarte, Lauren Coombs, Caleb Avery Lambert, Derek Van Booven, Brooke A. DeRosa, Margaret A Pericak‐Vance, Anthony J. Griswold, Derek M. Dykxhoorn
pmc-11710643.description: BackgroundWe identified the missense variant Ser1038Cys (rs377155188) in the tetratricopeptide repeat domain 3 (TTC3) gene that segregate in a non‐Hispanic white late onset Alzheimer disease (LOAD) family. This variant is predicted to be deleterious and extremely rare (MAF<0.01%). Expression of TTC3 is decreased in the brains of LOAD patients and negatively correlated with AD neuropathology.

pmc-12511582.title: Age-specific tumor-associated macrophage biomarkers underlie metastasis and immune dysregulation in thyroid cancer
pmc-12511582.creator: Tianyao Chu, Shenglong Xu, Hongyan Chen, Xinlei Zhang, Yan Zhao, Peng Zhang
pmc-12511582.description: Thyroid cancer (THCA) shows rising incidence and aggressiveness in young-onset cases. Through integrated single-cell, transcriptomic, and proteomic analyses, we identified age-specific tumor-associated macrophage (TAM) genes, including OLR1 and SIGLEC1, linked to metastasis and immune dysfunction. These TAM biomarkers were validated at the protein level, highlighting their prognostic and therapeutic potential.

pmc-12513214.title: Impact of staff turnover on extracorporeal cardiopulmonary resuscitation in out-of-hospital cardiac arrest patients: a nationwide registry-based analysis in Japan
pmc-12513214.creator: Kazuya Kikutani, Mitsuaki Nishikimi, Shinichiro Ohshimo, Nobuaki Shime
pmc-12513214.description: Highlights•We investigated the impact of physician staff turnover on outcomes in OHCA.•No significant difference in 30-day survival was found in overall OHCA cases.•Early April admission was associated with improved 30-day survival in ECPR patients.•Institutional readiness during staff turnover periods may improve outcomes in ECPR.

pmc-12577612.title: Thyroid Tuberculosis: Misdiagnosed as Papillary Thyroid Carcinoma – A Rare Case Report
pmc-12577612.creator: Yanhua Tong, Jiejie Yao, Yingzhen Chen, Qichun Yu, Yu Lu, Ming Xuan
pmc-12577612.description: BackgroundThyroid tuberculosis (TTB), either in its primary or secondary form, is a rare occurrence, even in recent years, with a high incidence of tuberculosis in China. Nowadays, with the increasing morbidity of thyroid nodules, it is apt to be misdiagnosed with malignant tumors.

pmc-12605559.title: CC/CXC chemokine risk signature at single-cell resolution: a machine learning model for precision stratification in cervical cancer
pmc-12605559.creator: Bing Xu, Xinyan Shi, Yanfei Liu, Lyuping Xu, Qingxue Zhou
pmc-12605559.description: BackgroundAdvanced cervical cancer has a poor prognosis due to chemoresistance and immunosuppression, while the prognostic value of chemokines-related genes (CRGs) remains underexplored. This study aimed to develop a prognostic signature based on CRGs and explore its clinical utility in cervical cancer risk stratification, microenvironment characterization, and therapeutic response prediction.

pmc-12988207.title: Quantum feedback-enhanced discord in T-shaped plasmonic waveguides with embedded cavity
pmc-12988207.creator: Hossein Sadeghi, Mehdi Mirzaee, Rezvan Zarei
pmc-12988207.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This theoretical study presents a hybrid quantum system that combines the geometry of a T-shaped plasmonic waveguide with an embedded common cavity and applies quantum feedback control to enhance and preserve quantum discord between two quantum dots (QDs). Building upon previous work on entanglement generation in T-shaped waveguides and feedback-enhanced discord in V-shaped waveguides, we demonstrate that the T-shape geometry with its specific boundary conditions, coupled with active feedback, offers superior control over quantum correlations.

pmc-13029378.title: Multifunctional Fe3O4@ZIF-8 Nanoparticles with Antibiosis and Osteogenesis for Treatment of Jaw Osteomyelitis
pmc-13029378.creator: Heng Li, Zhiyue Zhang, Yu Wang, Ting Mou, Jiaqi Tian, Chong Huang, Lu Zhao, Zeyang Ge, Dandan Wang, Chenlu Li, Jihong Wang, Yanzhen Zheng, Lei Tian, Chunlin Zong
pmc-13029378.description: Background/Objectives: Jaw osteomyelitis (OM) is a refractory purulent inflammation caused by bacterial infection, characterized by persistent infection, excessive bone resorption, and resultant bone defects. Currently, mainstream therapies for jaw OM struggle to eradicate persistent infections, avoid antibiotic resistance, and repair infected bone defects, posing a critical challenge in clinical practice.

pmc-13055755.title: Management of Liver Cirrhosis in Percutaneous and Surgical Cardiac Interventions
pmc-13055755.creator: Cristiano Spadaccio, Antonio Nenna, Krishna Mehta, Angelo Pisani, Asishana Osho, Fernando Juarez‐Casso, Domenico Alvaro, Imran Arif, Antonio Panza, Russell S. Vester, Louis B. Louis, Thoralf M. Sundt, Juan Crestanello, David Rose
pmc-13055755.description: The systemic impairment that accompanies liver cirrhosis is known to carry a significant burden on death and postoperative complications in cardiovascular interventions. This review analyzes the impact of liver cirrhosis on short‐ and long‐term outcomes after cardiac surgery and percutaneous procedures, providing an evidence‐based guidance in the decision‐making process and perioperative management of these patients.

pmc-13145582.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A692 RADIOLOGICAL DETERMINANTS OF TISSUE FATE IN PLAIN BRAIN COMPUTER TOMOGRAPHY DURING ACUTE LARGE VESSEL OCCLUSION: A MULTICENTER STUDY
pmc-13145582.creator: Haipeng Li, Billy Lam, Bianca Chan, Sze Ho MA, Trista Hung, Ho Ko, Hao Wang, Junjie Sai, Thomas Leung, Bonaventure Ym Ip
pmc-13145582.description: Background and aimsAlberta Stroke Program Early CT Score (ASPECTS), a semiquantitative assessment, is increasingly adopted on endovascular thrombectomy (EVT) triage. However, the relative contribution of components of baseline ASPECTS (hypoattenuation, loss of grey-white differentiation [LGWD], and sulcal effacement or edema in subcortical structures [SE]) to tissue fate in patients with large vessel occlusion (LVO) undergoing EVT is uncertain.

pmc-13242847.title: Histone Methylation: A Pivotal Epigenetic Driver of the Malignant Transformation of MASLD-HCC
pmc-13242847.creator: Yan Zhang, Tong Chen, Zhanjie Chang, Xinlei Qi, Ruijuan Yan, Haibo Zhang, Xi Guan, Shuguang Yan, Jingtao Li, Junzhe Jiao
pmc-13242847.description: Hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) is characterized by high invasiveness and drug resistance, resulting in a generally poor prognosis for patients. Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatotic Liver Disease (MASLD) and its advanced form, Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis (MASH), are important precancerous lesions of HCC. Interventions during the critical precancerous stage before the occurrence of HCC have been recognized as a core strategy to improve prognosis.

pmc-13323540.title: Daptomycin pharmacokinetics in critically ill patients receiving extracorporeal membrane oxygenation: A pilot cohort study
pmc-13323540.creator: Haofei Wang, Changde Wu, Xiwen Zhang, Jie He, Linlin Hu, Qing Li, Jianfeng Xie, Wei Huang, Yingzi Huang
pmc-13323540.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). llary leak, altered protein binding, fluid shifts, and potential drug sequestration within extracorporeal circuits—may substantially modify antimicrobial pharmacokinetics. These alterations raise concern for subtherapeutic exposure and treatment failure in a population already at high risk of nosocomial infection. Despite the frequent use of daptomycin for severe Gram-positive infections in intensive care units, data defining its pharmacokinetic behavior during ECMO remain limited [1].

pmc-13325454.title: Heterogeneous SPP1-expressing esophageal cancer cells license immunotherapy resistance by organizing an immunosuppressive niche
pmc-13325454.creator: Jiakang Ma, Jianlin Zhu, Yiling Chen, Xiaodong Chu, Jie Zeng, Hongyu Chen, Yuhao Liu, Xiaosheng Lin, Lei Zhang, Jinyuan Yi, Guangping Zhang, Songwang Cai, Yusheng Lin, Lu Wang

pmc-13340943.title: Advancing fetal autopsy in cases of maceration: Underwater dissection technique and its forensic relevance
pmc-13340943.creator: Francesca Buffelli, Sharon Duzioni, Valerio Gaetano Vellone, Alessandro Bonsignore, Ezio Fulcheri
pmc-13340943.description: Fetal autopsy remains essential for determining the cause of intrauterine death and for supporting clinical, genetic, and forensic evaluations. However, in cases of advanced maceration, autolysis severely compromises tissue integrity, often preventing adequate identification of anatomical structures and limiting the diagnostic and medico‐legal value of traditional autopsy.

pmc-13441817.title: Acidophil stem cell-like pituitary neuroendocrine tumors with heterogeneous PIT1/SF1 or LH lineage-marker expression: a clinicopathological study of three cases
pmc-13441817.creator: Hong Zheng, Xue Yang, Meili Zhang, Weiyi Chen
pmc-13441817.description: Acidophil stem cell-like pituitary neuroendocrine tumors are uncommon PIT1-lineage tumors with heterogeneous morphology and immunophenotypes. Their distinction from other PIT1-lineage tumors and from tumors with additional gonadotroph-lineage-marker expression remains challenging. We retrospectively analyzed three surgically resected acidophil stem cell-like PitNETs. Clinical, endocrine, radiological, operative, histological, immunohistochemical, and follow-up data were reviewed.
